findings.title: Detail page back control does not return to the originating list
findings.observed: Organizer reached the detail from /my-meetups via a visible card. The detail page's visible 뒤로가기 control (aria-label=뒤로가기) targets /, and keyboard focus + Enter navigated to / (탐색 home), not /my-meetups.
findings.interpretation: The back affordance is a fixed home link rather than origin-aware navigation, discarding the organizer's list context.
findings.friction: Mild; the persistent bottom nav makes recovery one extra tap, and nothing is lost. The return mechanism itself preserved the detail URL correctly.
findings.defect_claim_reason: no fresh-state reproduce-defect event and no independent business-truth oracle

findings.title: Actor-reported pointer interception not reproduced
findings.observed: Every pointer action in this run (nav links, meetup card, gate login control, form buttons) landed on the intended target with no interception or overlay blocking.
findings.interpretation: Classified non-reproduced; the Actor established no root cause and none is inferred here.

findings.title: Screenshot capture unavailable
findings.observed: page.screenshot() failed with 'CDP request timed out: Page.captureScreenshot' after 15002 ms and produced no PNG; no screenshot artifact exists.
findings.interpretation: Runtime/environment limitation of this QA session, matching the Actor's report; not app behavior.
findings.friction: Blocks visual-geometry, density, overlap, and narrow-viewport claims.

score_basis.interaction_clarity: Return path unambiguous; detail 뒤로가기 silently means home rather than the originating list (F1).
score_basis.error_recovery: Full reload-expiry to reauthenticate to same-object return loop completed with no dead ends.
score_basis.consistency: Reload expiry consistent and explained, but the detail back destination is inconsistent with the arrival list.
score_basis.accessibility_basics: Snapshot exposes real roles and accessible names, the phone field is a named textbox, and keyboard focus + Enter activated the back link; no screenshot to confirm focus styling, contrast, or narrow layout.
score_basis.perceived_friction: Recovery short and legible; recurring cost is one extra tap after the misleading back control.
